content.user_title: Manage CAPA Investigations and Corrective Actions
content.value_statement: Quality teams need consistent CAPA investigations, action plans, and effectiveness checks. This skill structures root cause analysis, preventive actions, metrics, and compliance-focused reporting.
actual_capabilities: Structures CAPA work from initiation through investigation, implementation, effectiveness verification, and closure.
Selects suitable root cause methods, including 5 Why, fishbone analysis, fault trees, human factors analysis, and FMEA.
Drafts measurable corrective and preventive actions with owners, milestones, resources, dependencies, and success criteria.
Defines CAPA metrics for cycle time, first-time effectiveness, recurrence, overdue actions, and investigation quality.
Organizes trend reviews and management reports around sources, processes, severity, root causes, and systemic risks.
limitations: Provides guidance and draft documentation, not regulatory, legal, or quality approval.
Does not replace subject-matter review or validation against internal procedures.
Bundled scripts, references, and assets are placeholders and do not implement the named CAPA tools.
Results depend on complete, accurate event data and evidence supplied by the user.

use_cases.title: Investigate a Quality Event
use_cases.description: Build a scoped investigation, select an RCA method, document evidence, and test proposed root causes.

use_cases.title: Create an Action Plan
use_cases.description: Convert confirmed causes into assigned corrective and preventive actions with milestones, measures, and verification criteria.

use_cases.title: Review CAPA Performance
use_cases.description: Summarize trends, overdue work, recurrence, effectiveness, and systemic risks for management review.

prompt_templates.title: Define a CAPA Problem
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this event into a clear CAPA problem statement: [event]. Include scope, impact, known facts, unknowns, and immediate containment needs.

prompt_templates.title: Select an RCA Method
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend an RCA method for this issue: [issue]. Explain the choice, required evidence, investigation steps, and criteria for confirming the root cause.

prompt_templates.title: Build a CAPA Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a CAPA plan from these confirmed causes: [causes]. Define actions, owners, milestones, dependencies, risks, success measures, and effectiveness checks.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze CAPA Trends
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these CAPA records: [records]. Identify systemic trends, prioritize risks, propose preventive actions, define metrics, and prepare a management summary.

output_examples.input: A packaging seal failure occurred on three lots after equipment maintenance.
output: Problem statement: Three lots showed seal failures after maintenance on the same packaging line.
Recommended method: Fishbone analysis supported by maintenance records, setup parameters, operator interviews, and seal-test results.
Next step: Contain affected lots and compare post-maintenance settings with validated settings.

output_examples.input: The confirmed root cause is an unclear inspection procedure with inconsistent operator training.
output: Corrective action: Revise the inspection procedure with explicit acceptance criteria and visual examples.
Training action: Qualify affected operators through observed performance and documented competency checks.
Effectiveness check: Audit 30 consecutive inspections after implementation and confirm no interpretation-related deviations.

output_examples.input: Summarize quarterly CAPA performance for management review.
output: Review cycle time, overdue rate, recurrence, first-time effectiveness, and investigation quality.
Group recurring causes by process area, source, severity, and product line.
Escalate adverse trends and assign preventive actions with measurable follow-up dates.

best_practices: Separate observed facts, assumptions, contributing factors, and confirmed root causes.
Link every action to a verified cause and define measurable effectiveness criteria before implementation.
Validate generated content against procedures, records, regulations, and accountable subject-matter experts.
anti_patterns: Do not close a CAPA after task completion without effectiveness evidence.
Do not treat retraining as the default action without investigating system and process causes.
Do not invent evidence, dates, owners, regulatory conclusions, or investigation results.

faq.question: What CAPA stages does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports initiation, scoping, investigation, root cause analysis, action planning, implementation monitoring, effectiveness verification, closure, and escalation.

faq.question: Which root cause methods can it apply?
faq.answer: It can guide 5 Why, fishbone analysis, fault tree analysis, human factors analysis, and FMEA selection.

faq.question: Can it approve CAPA closure?
faq.answer: No. An authorized quality professional must review evidence, confirm effectiveness, and approve closure under the applicable procedure.

faq.question: Does it provide regulatory advice?
faq.answer: It can organize compliance considerations, but it does not provide legal advice or determine regulatory acceptance.

faq.question: Can it analyze multiple CAPA records?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide structured, de-identified records to identify recurring sources, causes, delays, effectiveness gaps, and preventive action opportunities.

faq.question: Are the listed scripts and references included?
faq.answer: No. The bundled files are placeholders, and the specific tools and guides named in the skill are not implemented.
